title: , the All-Famed
name: Euphemia
troparia: (Tone 4) Your lamb, Euphemia, O Jesus, cries in a loud voice:* “You, O my Bridegroom, I love; and, seeking You, I undergo martyrdom.* And with You I am crucified and buried in Your baptism,* and I suffer for Your sake that I may reign with You.* And I die on Your behalf that I may live in You.* Receive me as a spotless sacrifice,* sacrificed for You with love.”* Through her intercession in Your mercy save our souls.
kontakia: (Tone 4) In your martyrdom you waged a good battle,* and after death you sanctify us with torrents of miracles.* Therefore we hymn your holy dormition,* coming to your divine church with faith,* seeking to be saved from spiritual ills* and to obtain the grace of your miracles.
